 n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0]); flat=[v for row in grid for v in row]
 out=[[flat[(r*m+c)%len(flat)] for c in range(2*m)] for r in range(2*n)]
 for r in range(n):
  for c in range(m): out[r][c]=grid[r][c]
 return out

def transform(grid):
 n=len(grid); cw=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]; ccw=[list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]; half=[row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
 return [grid[i]+cw[i] for i in range(n)]+[ccw[i]+half[i] for i in range(n)]
